answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with an exit cooldown. Before withdrawing earnings, an identity must announce its exit and wait several epochs with its stake frozen. In that window any peer may file a fraud proof against its work; a proven claim slashes the stake. Like a pulse checked before discharge, the wait forces every fake identity to stay exposed, so a Sybil operator with a hundred puppets pays a hundred locked stakes and a hundred risks, while one proven fraud ripples review through the whole cluster. Honest agents pass untouched and leave with a saffron clean-exit seal.
